answer: Draw three jurors per answer. Slash the one that diverges when the other two agree on the facts. Pay the rewarded jurors into a vesting stream that unlocks over 100 epochs, so a single lucky call is not cash. Idle keys lose standing each epoch, which kills stockpiled accounts. Follow the thread of each verdict across the tide of epochs and a farm shows as the karst of its dry, unused seats. Attack cost: three juror bonds per fake answer plus 100 epochs of waiting.
